subject: Vacant Building Ordinance and Zoning Cleanup
overview: The committee reviewed proposed technical and procedural cleanup amendments to the zoning ordinance, voting to keep the matter in committee until late April. It also reviewed revisions to the proposed vacant building ordinance and voted to refer it to a regular City Council meeting and to KP Law for legal review.

items.title: Zoning ordinance cleanup amendments
items.summary: Voted to keep proposed technical and procedural cleanup amendments to the zoning ordinance in committee, scheduling further review for late April after staff prepares consolidated redline documents and categorizes changes into tiers.

items.title: Vacant building ordinance
items.summary: Referred the proposed vacant building ordinance to the regular City Council meeting and to legal counsel for review, authorizing Councilor Tseng to incorporate edits on square-footage-tiered fees, enforcement discretion, and treatment of residential properties.
